verdict.rationale: Runpod's Serverless product explicitly supports autonomous background execution (scale-to-zero flex workers or always-on 24/7 active workers, pay-per-second billing) and Instant Clusters for large-scale distributed jobs run without manual infra management, while the Agent Skills/MCP integration lets an AI agent programmatically create Pods and deploy Serverless endpoints in natural language. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of scheduled or trigger-based automation workflows actually running unattended over time, and no third-party confirmation beyond vendor docs.
